description: This file implements a class JobStore that manages job lifecycle, persistence, and file operations for a system handling jobs that involve file uploads, status tracking, and metadata management. It includes functions to create jobs, update their status, save uploads, and clean up job directories. The file heavily interacts with filesystem directories for each job, handles JSON serialization for metadata, and references external models related to job detection summaries and statuses.

classes.name: JobPaths
classes.description: Container of filesystem paths for a specific job, including root, meta, uploads, work, and result directories.

methods.name: JobPaths _job_paths(base_dir: Path, job_id: str)
methods.description: Constructs and returns a JobPaths object for given base_dir and job_id.

methods.name: str _now_iso()
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp as an ISO 8601 string in UTC.

methods.name: JobCreated create_job(self, initial_status: JobState = JobState.PENDING, message: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Creates a new job directory with initial meta.json, returns a JobCreated object.

methods.name: dict _read_meta(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Reads and returns the metadata dictionary for a given job_id.

methods.name: None _write_meta(self, job_id: str, meta: dict)
methods.description: Writes the provided meta dictionary to the meta.json file for a given job_id.

methods.name: JobStatus update_status( self, job_id: str, *, status: Optional[JobState] = None, progress: Optional[int] = None, message: Optional[str] = None, result_url: Optional[str] = None, detections: Optional[List[PerFileDetectionSummary]] = None, )
methods.description: Updates the status, progress, message, result URL, and detections for a job and persists changes.

methods.name: JobStatus save_error(self, job_id: str, error_message: str)
methods.description: Records an error message and sets job status to ERROR.

methods.name: JobStatus get_status(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Loads and returns the current status and metadata of a given job.

methods.name: None save_uploads(self, job_id: str, drawings_zip_path: Path, logo_image_path: Path)
methods.description: Backward-compatible method to save uploads, including ZIP and logo.

methods.name: None save_uploads_flexible( self, job_id: str, logo_image_path: Path, drawings_zip_path: Optional[Path] = None, individual_files_dir: Optional[Path] = None, )
methods.description: Saves uploads supporting ZIP file, individual files, and a logo image, updates job status accordingly.

methods.name: Path get_uploads_dir(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the path to the uploads directory for a job.

methods.name: Path get_work_dir(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the path to the work directory for a job.

methods.name: Path get_result_dir(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the path to the result directory for a job.

methods.name: JobStatus set_result_url(self, job_id: str, result_url: str)
methods.description: Sets the result URL in job metadata and updates job status accordingly.

methods.name: None cleanup(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Removes the entire job directory and its contents.
